boatCard.before: Call the roll by name, every diver and every crew member, before you leave the dock and after every dive. Two people count. The roll call in the app is the record; if the phone is dead, call it against the printed manifest and write the time on it.
boatCard.missing: Note the time and mark the position. Do not leave the site. Call the roll again by name. Then call for help on the numbers below, and call the shop.
